motivation: Post-hoc response to the independent review frozen on 2026-10-08; prior dataset concentration was known. This is not preregistration of the study.
grouping_rule: Group by underlying collection/source domain before fitting the additional controls. Citation networks and coauthorship remain separate; all three Wikipedia-derived tasks are grouped conservatively despite their different graph construction. The WebKB pair is held out jointly. A shared PyG loader for Amazon-ratings and Roman-empire does not imply a shared data source.

influence.scenarios: All 11 datasets and every single-dataset omission, for every declared input/budget/portfolio. No refitting or changed actions in this influence calculation.
influence.report: Per-dataset regret, benefit, harm and contribution to the full mean; both constant references; all omission results. Full sample remains primary.

calibration.candidates: All training-score midpoints between successive distinct values, all-graph and all-MLP, in the existing order.
calibration.loss: Dataset-equal mean raw-accuracy regret across all seeds of the training datasets; each portfolio retains its own selected graph-versus-MLP oracle.
calibration.tie_rule: First candidate within tolerance of the minimum, matching the existing smallest-cutoff convention.
calibration.heldout_exclusion: Every held-out group member's scores and outcomes are excluded from candidate generation and fitting.
calibration.retain: Complete group definition, training rows, all candidates and losses, selected threshold, held-out rows/actions and per-dataset benefit/harm. Report each predeclared cell regardless of direction.

inference: Descriptive source-group and influence sensitivity only. No p-values or confidence intervals are added. Dataset groups are a declared robustness partition, not proof of independence or a population sample.
prohibited: changing the fixed CPM score or decisions
selecting groups or reporting cells after seeing new results
